children: Pictet Asset Management SA disclosed a 5.0% stake in Dynatrace, Inc.’s common stock. The firm reported the position on Sep. 02, 2026 after a series of August–September purchases. Pictet bought the shares for institutional clients and plans to engage Dynatrace’s leadership on strategy, governance, and sustainability.

Pictet says it invests in Dynatrace as part of a strategy that weighs long-term strategy, governance quality, financial strength, valuation, and sustainability risks and opportunities. It states it is “actively engaging with the Issuer to discuss and promote initiatives that align with these business practices,” including talks with the board and management.
Pictet adds that it “does not currently have any plans or proposals that would result in a change in control of the Issuer,” though it may adjust its approach as its engagement continues.

Pictet Asset Management SA is a Switzerland-based investment adviser within the Pictet Group, serving institutional clients worldwide. The firm focuses on active management and integrates sustainability considerations across many strategies. Pictet has a long history in European asset management and often engages portfolio companies on governance and long-term value creation.
